title: postapiauthloginwithvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password to verify successful authentication and receipt of JWT token with status 200.

title: postapiauthloginwithinvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /api/auth/login with invalid email or password to verify response with 400 Bad Request or 401 Unauthorized and appropriate error details.

title: getapiadmindashboardwithvalidjwtandauthorizedrole
description: Test GET /api/admin/dashboard with a valid JWT token and authorized user role to verify successful retrieval of dashboard data with status 200.

title: getapiadmindashboardwithoutjwtortokenwithinsufficientpermissions
description: Test GET /api/admin/dashboard without JWT token or with a token having insufficient permissions to verify response with 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.
